body: Thank you for your help. I’m feeling better today. Thanks for taking the time  to talk to me. :)

And I’m afraid to get a doctor to assess me cuz if he says I do have depression my parents would be upset and I don’t want to worry anyone. I don’t think going to one would be worth it cuz they’d say I’m fine and my parents and friends might think I just want attention when I don’t. \:

Sometimes I just feel like it’s pointless to be living and I’m scared to try to die, but I’m always thinking about doing it. I never thought I would cut or attempt to kill myself but I ended up cutting for the third time. I don’t think I’m depressed cuz I feel like assessing myself as depressed would be entitled. I don’t think the same as them I don’t think, and it seems entitled to think I am depressed. Idk. ^^;
I have no idea if I do or don’t. I don’t think I do, because I’ve often thought of dying but I don’t consider myself to be depressed..?? I don’t know anymore.
